Topics covered in this PDF

BCOE-143 (Fundamentals of Financial Management) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Objectives of financial management, NPV and IRR, CAPM and Arbitrage Pricing Theory, the Modigliani-Miller hypothesis, the operating cycle
  • Time value of money, payback period, valuation of equity shares, financial leverage and EPS, dividend declaration, profitability index, factoring and forfaiting, capital structure approaches, Walter and Gordon models

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: Tutor Marked Assignment, coverage all blocks, maximum marks 100. Section A: Q1 to Q5, 10 marks each. Section B: Q6 to Q10, 6 marks each. Section C: Q11 and Q12, each with two parts printed as 5x2. The cover Section C heading prints 10 marks per question; the page states this as printed

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.

How to use the solved PDF properly

This PDF is study and reference material. Use it like this:

  • Learn the answer structure from the PDF: introduction, concept or facts, examples and conclusion
  • Write your final answer in your own words. The university alone evaluates it
